d:
Fall in love with the playful romance of “Sweetheart” in stunning 8K, featuring Sushant Singh Rajput and Sara Ali Khan, with Dev Negi’s delightful vocals and Amit Trivedi’s melodious music.
Shaahi joda pehen ke
Aayi jo banthan ke
Vahi toh meri hai..
Song: Sweetheart
Singer: Dev Negi
Movie: Kedarnath
Music: Amit Trivedi
